name: Silvermaw, Dark Lord of Timbergorge

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Blanket of Black Flowers
traits.details: An enemy that ends its turn in the aura takes 10 necrotic damage, or 15 necrotic damage if Silvermaw is bloodied.

traits.name: Wooden Body
traits.details: Whenever Silvermaw takes fire damage, he also takes ongoing 5 fire damage (save ends).

traits.name: Resilient Nature
traits.details: If Silvermaw begins his turn affected by an effect that a save can end, he can make a saving throw against it. For each such saving throw he attempts, he takes 5 damage.

auras.name: Blanket of Black Flowers
auras.details: An enemy that ends its turn in the aura takes 10 necrotic damage, or 15 necrotic damage if Silvermaw is bloodied.

hit.description: damage, and Silvermaw pulls the target up to 5 squares.

powers.name: Vengeful Slam
powers.trigger: An enemy within 3 squares of Silvermaw bloodies him or scores a critical hit against him.

effect.description: Silvermaw uses slam against the triggering enemy.
